slides: Except it's locked inside your head
Midnight you're thinking about it but never write it Morning it's gone
If you keep your dreams fuzzy
Unwritten dreams are just fantasies you tell yourself
Write one down today Follow for the rules nobody taught you
caption:
Stop keeping your dreams in your head. This kills discipline and stunts your self improvement mindset.

Written clarity is how your subconscious gets programmed. It becomes your instruction set.

Vague dreams give you nothing to build from. Written ones give you everything.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#Discipline #SelfImprovement #MindsetShift #GoalSetting #SuccessHabits
